name: Marz-O-Rin
caption: The shutters go up at 8:30. MG Road has opinions about who was in the queue first.

name: Akshardhara Book Gallery
caption: Marathi books until 8:30 PM. Long enough to walk in for one and leave with a bag.

name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
season: All year; closed 26 January, 15 August and Anant Chaturdashi
caption: Open all year, except the three days everyone in Pune already has other plans.

name: Joshi's Museum of Miniature Railways
caption: The trains run every half hour. Provided four of you turn up. Pune has always believed in quorum.

name: Shreemant Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple
caption: Doors open at 5 AM. On Tuesdays they stay open half an hour longer. Even the schedule has a favourite day.

name: ISKCON NVCC Pune
caption: Mangala aarti at 4:30 AM. The rest of Kondhwa is still negotiating with its alarm.

name: Gyaan Adab
caption: Closed Mondays. Also the first and third Sundays. Carry a calendar and a backup plan.

name: Vetal Tekdi and ARAI hill loop
caption: 9.47 km of dirt path and no street lights. The tekdi keeps its own timings too.

name: Koregaon Park and Kalyani Nagar loop
caption: One loop, two neighbourhoods, one bridge crossed twice. 8.62 km to settle which side has better coffee.

name: Lohagad Fort
best_time: Early start; Saturdays are quieter in monsoon
caption: Half of Pune did its first fort here. The other half is on the steps right now.

name: Torna Fort
caption: The guide says do not make this your first trek. Pune will, of course, consider it a suggestion.

name: Rohida Fort
caption: A fort with two names and very few visitors. Both facts suit it.
